# Integration contract fixtures

These envelopes are not standalone regression documents. `version-bundle-linked.json`
freezes a revision's pinned template, anchored resolved discussion and captured linked
table. Its `snapshot.content` uses the stored document format; the surrounding bundle
uses the optional host version contract (DOCE-VERSIONS-5.5).

`linked-spreadsheet-capture.json` was generated by the spreadsheet library's
`createLinkedSpreadsheetInsertion` from `[["=21*2", "Note"], ["", "Captured"]]`, with
`A1` merged over two rows and an authoritative ready publication. It deliberately
retains only the transport `table.rows` boundary, not editor-specific node JSON.
The document bridge tests validate and convert these rows through existing document
builders without parsing the supplied HTML or recalculating the workbook.

The fixtures name DOCE-FORMAT-1.1, DOCE-FORMAT-1.2 and DOCE-FORMAT-9.9 stored
contracts as well as DOCE-EMBEDS-1.3 and DOCE-VERSIONS-5.5 integration contracts.

`field-room.json` fixes the named content, metadata, discussion and awareness namespace spelling and immutable discussion record shape. `src/collab/room-scope.test.ts` seeds and reads it through the public APIs.
